reasoning: This is the top-level meta-repository for the llm-d distributed inference serving stack (a CNCF sandbox project). It contains no application source code — no Go, Python, or Rust services, no operator controllers, no importable library packages. Instead it aggregates: (1) deployment guides with Helm charts and kustomize overlays for ~20 well-lit-path deployment patterns (optimized-baseline, prefill/decode disaggregation, wide expert-parallelism, tiered prefix cache, batch serving, etc.); (2) Dockerfiles for building vLLM-based container images across accelerators (XPU, CPU, ROCm); (3) helper scripts for guide rendering, linting, and CI dry-runs; (4) project governance documents (COMPONENTS.md, PROJECT.md, MAINTAINERS.md, OWNERS); and (5) patches for upstream dependencies. The actual component code (llm-d-router, llm-d-kv-cache, llm-d-routing-sidecar, llm-d-async, llm-d-batch-gateway, llm-d-latency-predictor, llm-d-workload-variant-autoscaler, etc.) lives in separate repositories under the llm-d GitHub organization. This repository's primary purpose is to provide tested, production-ready deployment configurations and documentation for composing those components into a complete inference serving stack on Kubernetes.
